inv.desc_es:
AV CONSULTORES, especialistas en oficinas, GESTIÓN DIRECTA Y TOTAL TRANSPARENCIA.
"Sabemos que SU TIEMPO IMPORTA, tenemos LA MEJOR OPCIÓN PARA SU NEGOCIO". 
 
Magnífico Local con uso de Oficina situado en área empresarial de referencia en Fuencarral, Planta Baja con acceso desde la calle divisible a partir de 500 m2., superficie exterior y luminosa. Excelentes comunicaciones.
El ambiente empresarial ideal para desarrollar su negocio.

Local-Oficina en Planta Baja de 1.300 m² 
Distribuidos en dos plantas. Divisibles a partir de 500 m²

Exterior y luminoso. 
Distribuido en dos amplios espacios diáfanos de trabajo
Sala de reuniones, archivo/almacén y dos aseos.

FALSO TECHO desmontable.
ILUMINACION LED.
SUELO TÉCNICO.
Dos entradas principal y secundaria.
Grandes ventanales.
Instalación de fuerza y cableado en el perímetro de la oficina.
CLIMATIZACION: Frío-calor.
Nuestra oficina técnica a través de su equipo de arquitectos e interioristas le ofrecerá las mejores soluciones constructivas para la distribución y diseño de su espacio de trabajo.

Gastos comunes incluidos. 

Distancias a:
- Aeropuerto Madrid-Barajas 10 Km.
- Estación RENFE-Chamartín 2 Km.

Transporte Público
- Autobuses: 66, 137, 154
- Metro: Fuencarral (Línea 10)

inv.desc_en:
AV CONSULTORES, office specialists, WITHOUT AGENCY FEES!
DIRECT MANAGEMENT AND TOTAL TRANSPARENCY.
"We know that YOUR TIME MATTERS, we have THE BEST OPTION FOR YOUR BUSINESS".

Magnificent Local with use of an Office located in a business area of reference in Fuencarral, exterior and bright surface.Excellent communications and proximity to restaurants and services.The ideal business environment to develop your business.

Local-Office of 1.300 m² distributed over two floors.Divisible from 500 m²
Exterior and bright.
Distributed in two large open-plan work spaces, meeting room, file / warehouse and two toilets.
Detachable FALSE CEILING.
LED LIGHTING.
TECHNICAL FLOOR.
Two main and secondary entrances.
Large windows.
Installation of force and wiring in the perimeter of the office.
CLIMATE: Cold-heat.
Our technical office through its team of architects and interior designers will offer you the best constructive solutions for the distribution and design of your workspace.

Common expenses included.

Distances to:
- Madrid-Barajas Airport 10 Km.
- RENFE-Chamartín station 2 Km.

Public transport
- Buses: 66 and 137
- Metro: Fuencarral (Line 10) at 700 meters

LEGAL NOTICE: We remind our clients that the information provided does not constitute an authentic binding or contractual offer.This advertisement is provisional, and the photographs and data included in it are subject to possible modifications, as a result of commercial, legal, technical requirements or by express mandate of the property.The information contained herein tries to reflect an orientation on the properties as of the date of its publication.All content that appears is merely informative and approximate, and is not in any way contractual.Both the data, the images and plans may be subject to change, so we invite you, if you need more exact and detailed information, contact us and we will assist you as soon as possible.The contents are for information purposes only and under no circumstances should they be used or considered as an offer for sale or financing, request for a purchase or financing offer, or recommendation to carry out any other transaction, unless expressly indicated.The information and documentation to be offered in accordance with the provisions of Royal Decree 515/1989 (of April 21, relative to the protection of consumers regarding the information to be supplied in the sale and rental of homes), will be made available to disposition of potential buyers in the respective territorial delegations managing the property.".
